provenance.source_kind: peer-reviewed Kepler TTV first-order MMR systems (Table 1)
provenance.independence: Orbital period values are authoritative published observational discovery parameters from Holman et al. (2010), Cochran et al. (2011), Steffen et al. (2012), and MacDonald et al. (2016). Expected super-periods are evaluated directly from the first-order beat frequency relation.
provenance.limitations: These benchmarks test the first-order TTV super-period beat frequency equation. Full numerical TTV inversion requires N-body integration for mass and eccentricity constraints.
